Table of Contents


Toggle


You can make UPI payments through eligible RuPay credit cards. Linking a card combines the convenience of scanning a merchant QR code with the short-term credit facility offered by your card issuer.


[UPI is a convenient payment method](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/upi-full-form-meaning-how-it-works/) . Originally, it primarily worked with savings and current accounts. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) subsequently allowed RuPay credit cards to be linked to UPI. This allows users to make eligible merchant payments with their credit cards through a supported UPI app.


Linking credit cards to UPI can be a convenient way to make digital payments on credit without having to pay upfront, whether for shopping online or paying eligible merchant bills. However, you cannot use this facility for sending money to friends and family.


In this blog, we’ll walk you through the steps to link your credit card to UPI, so you can start using UPI on credit, understand where it works and manage repayments.


### TL;DR


- Link an eligible RuPay credit card through the credit-card-on-UPI option in a supported app and set its UPI PIN.
- Pay eligible merchants using their QR code or online UPI checkout. Transfers to individuals and cash withdrawals are not permitted.
- Check available credit, applicable limits and card charges. UPI purchases appear on your credit card bill and must be repaid.


##


What Are the Benefits of Linking Credit Cards to UPI for Customers?


Linking a credit card to UPI offers several benefits to users. First of all, UPI makes it convenient to make payments using our mobile phones rather than carrying actual cards or going to bank offices. However, prior to this, UPI was primarily linked to savings or current accounts.


Following the[RBI announcement allowing RuPay credit cards to be linked with UPI](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/rbi-launches-rupay-credit-cards-on-upi-cross-border-bill-payments/) , consumers can use the short-term credit facility offered by their credit cards to make eligible UPI transactions. This eliminates the need to transfer funds from their savings account for each purchase or carry a physical card. It also avoids exposing the physical card to skimming at POS terminals during that payment.


Eligible purchases may earn rewards, depending on the card’s terms, exclusions and caps. Linking does not create an additional credit limit: purchases use the available limit on your existing card.


##


Prerequisites for Linking a RuPay Credit Card to UPI


Before we get started on how to link a credit card to UPI, it’s important to keep the following handy:


- Download a UPI-enabled app on your smartphone. Some popular UPI apps in India are Google Pay, PhonePe and Paytm. Check that your app supports your issuing bank.
- An active, eligible **RuPay credit card** that you wish to link to UPI.
- The mobile number registered with your credit card issuer. The same number must be registered on the[UPI app](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/top-upi-apps-in-india/) , with its SIM available for verification.
- Outgoing SMS service and the card details requested during setup. Make sure your app is updated.


Visa, Mastercard and American Express credit cards cannot currently be linked through the RuPay-credit-card-on-UPI facility. Saving one of these cards in a payment app does not enable credit-card-funded UPI payments.


##


How Do I Link a Credit Card to UPI?


Now, let’s take a look at the steps to link your credit card to UPI:


1. **Register on the UPI app:** To get started, register your mobile number on the UPI app and complete its verification process. Use the number registered with your card issuer.
2. **Link Credit Card to UPI:** Go to the profile or payment-method section and look for the option to add a RuPay credit card. Depending on the app you use, it can be labelled ‘Add RuPay Credit Card’ or ‘Link Credit Card’. Select your issuing bank and the eligible card shown.
3. **Enter Credit Card Details:** You will need to enter the credit card details requested by the app, commonly the last six digits of the card number and expiration date. Follow the RuPay-on-UPI setup flow.
4. **Verify Your Card:** After entering your credit card details, you will need to verify them by providing the One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your registered mobile number, where prompted.
5. **Set the UPI PIN:** Complete the PIN setup or use the existing UPI PIN for that card where supported. Your credit card’s ATM/POS PIN and its UPI PIN are separate.


Your credit card has been linked to UPI. You can now use your credit card to make eligible merchant payments using UPI. Never share your OTP or UPI PIN with another person.


### How to Add a RuPay Credit Card to Google Pay


According to Google Pay’s RuPay credit card setup guide:


1. Open Google Pay and tap your profile picture.
2. Select **Add RuPay credit card** .
3. Choose your card-issuing bank and select the card you want to add.
4. Complete verification with the details requested.
5. Follow the instructions to set or enter the card’s UPI PIN.


Use the RuPay-specific option. A general ‘add card’ option may save a card for other payment features. Labels can vary with app updates.


### How to Add a RuPay Credit Card to PhonePe


Open PhonePe and look for the RuPay credit card option in its payment-method or payment-management section. Choose your issuer and eligible card, complete verification and set the card’s UPI PIN as prompted.


The card must be associated with the mobile number registered on PhonePe. If your issuer or card does not appear, check support with the bank before retrying.


##


How to Pay via UPI Using a Credit Card


Once the card is linked, select it as the funding source for an eligible merchant payment:


1. Scan the merchant’s[UPI QR code](https://www.cashfree.com/upi-qr-code/) or select a supported UPI app at online checkout.
2. Check the merchant name and amount.
3. Choose the linked RuPay credit card from your available payment accounts.
4. Authorise the payment with its UPI PIN, or another supported authentication method offered by your app.
5. Check the final payment status and retain the transaction reference.


At online checkout, return to the merchant’s page and check the order confirmation too. Your[UPI ID or VPA](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/vpa-in-upi/) identifies the linked payment account; the selected funding source determines whether the purchase uses your bank balance or credit card.


##


Where Can You Use Credit Card to UPI Payments?


Acceptance depends on the merchant, its payment setup, your issuer and the transaction category. A QR code accepting bank-account UPI payments does not automatically accept RuPay credit card payments.


**Transaction** **Availability through a linked RuPay credit card**


Eligible shop or restaurant merchant payment Supported where credit-card-on-UPI acceptance is enabled.


Eligible online merchant checkout Supported when the checkout and UPI app offer the linked card.


Sending money to friends or family Not permitted.


Transferring money to a bank account or another credit card Not permitted through this facility.


Cash withdrawals Not permitted.


Restricted categories such as mutual funds or IPOs Not permitted under the applicable restrictions.


##


Credit Card to UPI Payment Limits and Charges


### What Is the Payment Limit?


Your available credit, issuer controls and applicable[UPI transaction limits](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/upi-transaction-limit/) determine what you can pay. A large credit limit does not guarantee that the entire amount can be spent in one UPI transaction.


Newly linked cards may also face temporary restrictions. Check the card’s UPI limit with your issuer before a large purchase; general bank-account transfer limits may not describe your card’s allowance.


### Are There Charges or Rewards?


Check your issuer’s terms. For example, SBI Card’s UPI FAQs state that it does not charge for linking or carrying out UPI-on-credit-card transactions. Regular card terms, including applicable interest, late fees and category-specific charges, still matter.


Merchant acceptance charges are separate from the customer’s card bill. A merchant’s processing cost does not establish what your issuer charges you.


Rewards also depend on the card and purchase category. Check exclusions, spending caps and offer terms before assuming a UPI purchase earns the same rewards as a direct card payment.


##


Why Can’t I Link My Card or Complete a Payment?


Check the point at which the process stops:


- **Card not found:** Confirm that it is an eligible RuPay card and that the issuer supports your app.
- **Verification fails:** Check the registered number, selected SIM, outgoing SMS service and details entered.
- **Card linked but payment declined:** Check merchant acceptance, available credit, issuer limits and whether the card is blocked.
- **Payment pending:** Check the app and card transaction history before trying again. Repeating an uncertain payment can complicate reconciliation.


If the issue continues, contact the app or issuer with the date, amount and[transaction reference number](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-a-utr-number/) . Avoid sending your full card number, OTP or PIN in a support message.


##


Challenges of Linking a Credit Card to UPI


Linking credit cards with UPI has made it very convenient for users, but it also poses a risk of overspending if not monitored. Keeping track of numerous UPI transactions made through credit cards can be challenging, potentially leading to larger credit card bills with finance charges if not promptly paid. It’s crucial for consumers to monitor their spending and only spend within their means.


Review purchases in both the UPI app and credit card statement. Pay the total amount due by the due date to preserve interest-free benefits where applicable under your card’s terms. Linking a card changes how you pay at checkout; repayment remains your responsibility.
